DataDump.description:
The `scull-data.json` document: every table with its columns and rows (values as recorded).
Only used for the schema; the file is streamed in the same shape.

tables.description: Every table, in a fixed order.

FsPath.description:
A filesystem path as it appears in plans, JSON output and the database.

Serialized as a string. Paths that aren't valid Unicode (possible on Unix and Windows) are
converted lossily with U+FFFD and flagged by [`FsPath::is_lossy`]; the engine never acts on
a path read back from JSON alone. Items are matched by [`crate::ItemId`] and file identity,
and candidates are re-derived from the disk before execution (SAFE-05, SAFE-11).

rows.description:
Rows, keyed by column name. Integers and reals are numbers, text is a string, NULL is
`null`, a BLOB is a hex string.

description: A JSON document: schema identifier, scull version and the payload.

version.description: The scull version that produced this document.
